prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Card Stage Redesign: Redesign the initial story screen into a stage layout featuring companion animations and vibrant intro cards. This gives immediate visual feedback about what the desktop pet app offers before path selection.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Bring your virtual pet to life directly on your desktop screen.", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "label": "Preview Pet", "style": "playful"}]}}
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls Guide Screen: Insert a dedicated new control overview screen before the home intro screen that explains how to hide, drag, and interact with the desktop pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Ready to Interact With Your Pet!"}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_desktop_guide", "home_intro"]}
2: [adoption, new_flow] Multi-Step Pet Customization Sub-Flow: Add an interactive trait selection screen into the adoption sequence prior to generating the adoption certificate.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "carousel", "headline": "Choose Your Companion Archetype"}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "new_trait_selection", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
3: [sign_in, redesign] Account Persistence Spotlight Sign-in: Redesign the sign-in screen into a spotlight layout emphasizing cloud backup and pet recovery guarantees.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Protect Your Pet with Cloud Sync", "body": "Sign in to save your pet's memory, items, and settings safely to your account.", "replace": {"sign_in_options": [{"type": "button", "label": "Sign In to Save Progress", "style": "emphasis", "action": "choose", "role": "sign_in_options"}]}}}
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop Generation Progress & Estimate: Display explicit status progress indicators and remaining time estimates on the waiting screen while the desktop pet environment initializes.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "hint": "Setting up your desktop companion. This usually takes around 1 to 2 minutes."}}
5: [choose_path, copy] Explicit Path Selection Guidance Copy: Update the choose_path screen headline, body text, and button labels to clearly contrast standard companion selection versus photo-based custom pet creation.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Choose How to Begin", "body": "Select a ready-made digital companion or generate a unique pet from your photos.", "button_label": "Continue with Path"}}
6: [adoption, hint] Photo Quality & Lighting Hint: Add an inline quality tip on the upload_photos screen specifying ideal lighting and pose for optimal pet generation.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Upload well-lit, forward-facing photos for the crispest 3D pet generation."}}
7: [finish, incentive] Starter Accessory Reward Banner: Display a welcome badge and starter hat reward claim component on the home intro screen upon completing setup.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Onboarding Complete! Here is Your Free Pet Accessory", "body": "Your pet is now active on your desktop. Enjoy your exclusive starter hat accessory!", "components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Starter Pack Unlocked", "style": "playful"}]}}
8: [sign_in, reorder] Pre-Choice Account Sign-In Step Order: Move the sign_in screen to occur immediately after the initial story screen, before pet path choice.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign In First to Protect Your Creation"}, "_order": ["story", "sign_in", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
9: [home, notification] Desktop Ready System Notification Switch: Enable desktop notification alerts on the waiting screen to inform users when pet initialization completes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "headline": "Preparing Desktop Pet", "body": "You can use other apps while we prepare. We will notify you as soon as your pet arrives."}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigning the story screen layout retains its function of introducing the pet and respects all base rules.
Adding a new controls guide screen inside onboarding retains all required steps and respects rule limits.
Adding a trait selection sub-flow inside onboarding is allowed and preserves all required steps.
Redesigning sign-in layout while keeping sign-in functionality complies with all base rules.
Displaying progress and a real wait time estimate on the waiting screen is explicitly allowed under Rule 5.
Updating choose_path text while continuing to offer both adoption and custom pet creation respects Rule 2.
Adding photo guidance text to the upload screen does not violate any base rules.
Onboarding copy mentions 'Free Pet Accessory', which violates the Rule 3 prohibition against mentioning free extras or gifts.
Moving the sign-in step before path selection is explicitly permitted by Rule 4.
Enabling notification alerts on the waiting screen is allowed inside onboarding.
